name: budget-ladder-optimized
description: The byte ladder under the optimized recipe: per-budget luma precision (3 b at <=18 B, 4 b to 56 B, 5 b above) with chroma one bit under, plus aniso=1.2, sel_hv=0.15, scale_fit=2 and ac_nearest. Constants only - no extra encode compute. Compare against budget-ladder.json (shipped constants) and budget-ladder-tuned.json (the previous round's recipe).
